html:
SMTO-SKL-0144 — The Slack request was stopped before it finished

GUID: 0935d53d-2af6-52ac-96a2-3452fd87a8de
Slug: slack-operation-cancelled
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • The task was stopped while SMTO was working with Slack, so the rest of the work didn't happen. Anything Slack had already finished before the stop is still in place.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Slack and look at the channel, thread or files you were working with to see which parts of the request already happened. Steps finished before the stop are real and won't be undone.
  2. Ask the Agent to do only the parts that are still missing, and say exactly which message, file or channel you mean. Asking for everything again could repeat a message or change that already went through.
  3. If you didn't mean to stop the task, let the new request run to the end without pressing Stop. Stopping the task is what ended this Slack request.

What success looks like

  • Slack shows each change you wanted exactly once, and the new request finishes without stopping.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, especially if the task stopped without anyone pressing Stop. Don't repeat a post or upload until you've checked it isn't already in Slack.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Slack work stopped at a cancellation check because the caller's cancel event or the socket owner was cancelled during a request, transfer or file hash step.

What this means

  • Caller or transport-owner cancellation is observed at a request/transfer checkpoint. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Caller or transport-owner cancellation is observed at a request/transfer checkpoint.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect prior receipts and whether a write had already been dispatched.

How to fix it

  • SlackClient.check_cancelled observed native cancellation before or between requests and chunks. Inspect Slack for writes completed earlier in the run (for uploads, an allocated file_id may exist without being shared); a write cancelled after dispatch is reported separately as slack.mutation_outcome_unknown. Re-issue only the missing work.
  • The operation was cancelled. Resume reads only when requested; an in-flight write remains outcome_unknown.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • Explicit continuation preserves earlier effects and reconciles uncertain writes.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
